🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Family fun and local flavor this weekend in Tesoro Highlands.

🎃 *Fri 6 PM* — Mission View Trunk or Treat (free)
   Free trunk-or-treat for all ages—festive and easy.
🌽 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce and community vibe Saturday morning.
🧱 *Sat 12 PM* — Geoffrey's birthday: build and take home a free LEGO giraffe (free)
   Free LEGO building activity keeps kids engaged and happy.
📚 *Sat 11 AM* — Family Storytime (free)
   Cozy library storytime for the littlest listeners.
👻 *Fri 7 PM* — Bar Harbor Scares (free)
   Spooky scares that work for families and thrill-seekers.
🍺 *Fri 6 PM* — Live Music at Lucky Luke Brewing
   Live music and craft beer for adults to unwind Friday.
📖 *Sun 2:30 PM* — Silent Book Club (free)
   Quiet time to read with fellow book lovers Sunday afternoon.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
